observations.finding: Hovedartikkelens metode omtaler permutasjon og økning i MSE for variabelviktighet; vedleggets S4/S6-tekster omtaler Gini-impurity. Beskrivelsene er forskjellige; faktisk implementasjon er ikke fastslått.

no attempt to choose which description is authoritative without code

proposal.baselineLabel: mean of observed2015–2017; not expected no-drought yield

functions.baseline: B(country,crop,measure)=mean(x2015,x2016,x2017), only if all3 values comparable and nonmissing
functions.productionYieldArea: Report total output and yield separately; no simple average of winter/spring yields. Aggregate production/area only with exhaustive mutually exclusive crop mapping and source approval of calculation.

cropPolicy.wheat: separate winter/spring where available; common-wheat/spelt versus wheat-total labels must be compared explicitly; all grain is not food-grade wheat
cropPolicy.barley: total barley not interchangeable with spring barley; paper2026 has only spring barley model
cropPolicy.national_vs_regional: Use national totals for4-country descriptive comparison; do not average county yields or equate studies regional groups to Norden

moisturePolicy.otherCountriesAndEurostat: unknown in this method task; owner/parent must attach actual metadata before absolute-level comparison
moisturePolicy.formulaIfNeeded: At constant dry matter Q_target=Q_source*(100-m_source)/(100-m_target); applies to quantity, and yield only with unchanged area definition
moisturePolicy.withinSeries: A fixed moisture-conversion factor cancels in baseline index; changes of basis over time still require correction

interpretationLimits: three-year baseline is sensitive to harvest variability and trend
2015–2020 yields at most6 annual points; no stable correlation, return-period or independence estimate
2018 differences are descriptive, not climate-attributed causal losses
2019/2020 are followup harvests, not demonstrated recovery from the same cause
Do not infer Nordic additionality or circular additionality from coincident country declines
